prose: With Libra season in full swing, it's time for the 12th installment of our incredible Astro-Herbalism series, as we examine the doctrine of signatures and expressions in the plant kingdom that demonstrate Libran ideas encoded in nature. Herbal teachers Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs) and Michelle Lundquist (Michelle's Healing Home) reprise their roles for (at least) one more super-stream, alongside our favorite symbolic synchromystics Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies) and Gabe (Slick Dissident).
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
